summary: LOKITA Expo+FastAPI+Mongo — full backend regression (27/27 pytest cases pass) and buyer-side mobile UI smoke pass. Verified: phone+OTP+PIN auth (dev_otp auto-fill), community join via LOKITA code, data isolation (user without active community gets 400 on /market/stores), seller/store/products visible per community, cart grouping per store, checkout with unique order_no >=1000 (observed #1014), server-time timers (seconds_to_confirm/seconds_to_cancel_end/buyer_can_cancel), buyer cancel <=1min, full seller forward state machine confirm→proses→siap→antar→handover→menunggu_penyelesaian, buyer received + COD payment verify completes to SELESAI, seller reject 'Produk Habis' returns recommendations and restores stock, QRIS→COD switch allowed only when not SEDANG_DIVERIFIKASI/BERHASIL (same order id preserved), titip rejected when <2 proofs or titip_allowed=false, chat 403 for non-participant, ratings blocked pre-SELESAI, admin metrics requires platform role (403 for buyer), account deletion blocked when active orders exist and wrong-PIN returns 401, file upload accepted. Mobile UI buyer smoke confirmed: login→OTP auto-fill→create PIN→join community→Beranda shows Warung Bu Sri→store detail→product→add to cart→cart→checkout COD→order detail shows status 'Menunggu Konfirmasi', 5-min confirm countdown and 1-min cancel countdown with 'Batalkan Pesanan' button, Rp20.000 total, timeline entry 'Pesanan dibuat'.
action_items: No action required for tested surface. Future hardening (not blocking): expose seller segmented control (Pembelian/Penjualan) consistently on /pesanan — observed stable in session 1 but tab-switch could not be reasserted after storage reset; main agent can self-verify.
Consider end-to-end auto-cancel scheduler check in a long-running test (5-min wait) — logic verified by code review (CONFIRM_SECONDS=300, sweep every 20s).
critical_code_review_comments: orders.py:184 next_order_no returns 1000+seq — satisfies global unique >=1000 requirement.
orders.py:_auto_cancel_sweep correctly restores stock and notifies both parties.
orders.py:switch_to_cod blocks when payment_status in (BERHASIL, SEDANG_DIVERIFIKASI) and preserves same order id — matches locked rule.
orders.py:seller_titip enforces titip_allowed + >=2 proof files owned by seller with kind=proof.
chat.py:send_message blocks when status==SELESAI returning 400; messages endpoint exposes view_only flag.
misc.py:delete_account anonymizes identity, revokes sessions, blocks when active orders exist.
core.py:require_platform returns 403 when roles do not intersect — admin/metrics protection verified.
communities.py:join_community updates active_community_id and inserts membership; join invalid code→404.
marketplace.py:_active_cid returns 400 for users without active community — enforces isolation.
